foundation_llm.label: Foundation LLM
foundation_llm.description: Billions-parameter scale language predictors pre-trained on massive web crawl corpora.

decision_flow.question: Do you need raw, unbiased text completion and parameter scale?
decision_flow.if_no: Consider Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models for sparse computation savings.

instruction_tuned_llm.label: Instruction-Tuned / Aligned LLM
instruction_tuned_llm.description: Models fine-tuned to follow user prompts and aligned via safety feedback.

decision_flow.question: Are you building a user-facing chatbot or zero-shot assistant agent?
decision_flow.if_no: Use base Foundation LLMs for raw text completions.

multimodal_llm.label: Multimodal LLM
multimodal_llm.description: Language architectures integrating image tokens to read visual inputs.

decision_flow.question: Does your reasoning task require reading visual elements, diagrams, or UI layouts?
decision_flow.if_no: Use cheaper, faster text-only decoder models.

small_efficient_llm.label: Small / Efficient LLM
small_efficient_llm.description: Compact parameter models optimized for local edge deployment and CPU architectures.

decision_flow.question: Are you running models offline on-device or need sub-cent hosting budgets?
decision_flow.if_no: Use API-hosted foundation models for advanced logical tasks.

embedding_llm.label: Text Embedding Models
embedding_llm.description: Encoder transformers projecting semantic inputs into vector coordinates.

decision_flow.question: Are you indexing documents for semantic search retrieval or RAG databases?
decision_flow.if_no: Use decoder language models for text generation.
